0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The careworn cleaner appears to be in a spot of bother.

24.original: Collect the True Vue refuse sacks.

26.original: Express your /doubt to the leering delinquent.

27.original: Hand over the True Vue refuse sacks to the careworn cleaner.

48.original: Oh, come to check up on me, have you? I appreciate your concern. As you can probably tell, I'm feeling a little out of sorts.

50.original: Shall I fetch a healer for you?

51.original: Do you need me to escort you somewhere?

53.original: Oh no, there's no need for that. I have a condition, you see─it makes me numb and lethargic from time to time. Nothing a little rest won't put right, though.

54.original: The trouble is, when I get like this, I'm in no state to work. I hate to presume, but would you be willing to lend a hand?

55.original: I'm one of the cleaners in charge of True Vue. I was then getting ready to collect the last of the refuse sacks and call it a day when my condition flared up... I'd be ever so grateful if you could finish my rounds for me.

56.original: Please, it's only a few refuse sacks. You'd be doing me a real kindness. I can barely feel my arms and legs...

57.original: Ohoho! You look damn near death! What's the matter!?

58.original: Huh? Whatever's ailin' ye got to your tongue, has it!?

59.original: A-Ah, there you are... I, err...these fellows have─

60.original: Our ol' pal here's feeling under the weather─can't finish his work. So he offers to pay us─generously, I might add─to get the job done! In other words, ain't got no need for the likes o' you. Go on, piss off!

61.original: This is clearly nothing more than a brazen attempt at extortion. Turn the full force of your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>doubt<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> on the leering delinquent.

62.original: Of all the days they could have picked...

63.original: Listen, we've got our ol' pal here covered! Do yerself a favor and walk away before this gets ugly.

64.original: Lemme get this straight, <hex:021A020203>you're<hex:021A020103> the one our ol' pal here asked to help? Hah! What a load o' shite!

65.original: H-Hold on a moment. This <hex:020811E905FF056C617373FF0766656C6C657203> looks like <hex:020810E905FF067368652773FF056865277303> seen a fair few scrapes... Wait, don't tell me they're a bloody hunter!

66.original: A hunter? Sod this for a lark! I'd rather keep me head!

67.original: Look, I just told you. <hex:021A020203>We're<hex:021A020103> dealin' with this feller's problems. If you know what's good for you, you'll turn around and keep walkin'.

68.original: This is clearly nothing more than a brazen attempt at extortion. Turn the full force of your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>doubt<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> on the leering delinquent.

69.original: Phew... I dread to think what would've happened if you hadn't showed up. Ah, am I right to assume you've finished collecting the refuse sacks for me?

70.original: Excellent, I'll take care of these. I must say─refuse collection, civic protection...you're a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> of many talents. You have my gratitude.

71.original: This sector isn't exactly the safest in the city... Shakedowns and racketeering are unfortunately rather commonplace.

72.original: Usually, I try to leave as soon as I finish my rounds, but today my luck ran out and I had one of my turns.

73.original: This condition─it's caused by sensitivity to lightning energy. I hear the worst affected are all but bedbound by paralysis, so perhaps I should count myself lucky that my symptoms are relatively mild.

74.original: But enough about that. Thanks to you, I feel more or less back to my usual self. To think that I'd run into someone as virtuous as you on True Vue.
